newsitem.title: USA: Calcomp sees more restructuring charges.
newsitem.headline: Calcomp sees more restructuring charges.

text.p: CalComp Technology Inc, a supplier of computer graphics peripheral products, said on Friday it would take additional restructuring charges in the fourth quarter, writing off its headquarters and trimming 50 more positions from its staff.
In addition, CalComp said it reached an agreement with majority shareholder, Lockheed Martin Corp, to boost its credit line to $73 million from the current $33 million.
In a statement, CalComp said the added charges would boost the total restructuring cost to $21 million, or $0.46 a share, which is $14 million above the previously planned amount.
